title: Vowel or Consonant
statement:
Decide whether a letter is a vowel or a consonant.

The input is one lowercase letter from `a` to `z`. Print `vowel` when it is one of `a`, `e`, `i`, `o`, or `u`, and `consonant` for every other letter. The letter `y` counts as a consonant.

Input:

```text
e
```

Expected output:

```text
vowel
```
hints: Five letters share the same answer, so they can share one case.
Every letter that is not a vowel can fall into the default case.

python.solution:
def classify_letter(letter: str) -> str:
    match letter:
        case "a" | "e" | "i" | "o" | "u":
            return "vowel"
        case _:
            return "consonant"


letter = input().strip()
print(classify_letter(letter))
